## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] API or schema
- [ ] Database migration
- [ ] Runtime or Tool Gateway
- [ ] Memory or Skill lifecycle
- [ ] Console
- [ ] Documentation only

## Validation

List the exact commands run and their results.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] I did not commit credentials, tenant data, private prompts, or generated runtime state.
- [ ] I documented any API, database, configuration, or deployment compatibility impact.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I discussed major domain, database, Runtime, or security-boundary changes in an Issue first.
